enable_language(OBJCXX)

# The kernel source is compiled by Metal at run time; it is embedded as a string literal.
set(_metal_src ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/path_trace.metal)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${_metal_src})
file(READ ${_metal_src} _metal_code)
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/path_trace_metal.inl
     "// Generated by CMake from path_trace.metal. Do not edit.\nstatic const char kPathTraceSource[] = R\"msl(${_metal_code})msl\";\n")

add_library(gpu_path_trace_metal STATIC metal_runner.mm)
target_link_libraries(gpu_path_trace_metal PUBLIC
    bench_common
    gpu_path_trace_core
    "-framework Foundation"
    "-framework Metal"
)
target_include_directories(gpu_path_trace_metal PUBLIC ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
target_include_directories(gpu_path_trace_metal PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR})
target_compile_options(gpu_path_trace_metal PRIVATE -fobjc-arc)
target_compile_features(gpu_path_trace_metal PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
set_target_properties(gpu_path_trace_metal PROPERTIES
    POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON
    CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET     hidden
)
target_compile_definitions(gpu_path_trace_metal INTERFACE GPU_PATH_TRACE_HAVE_METAL)
set(GPU_PATH_TRACE_HAVE_METAL TRUE PARENT_SCOPE)
